CloneJob.description: CloneJob describes the process of creating a clone of a MigratingVM to the requested target based on the latest successful uploaded snapshots. While the migration cycles of a MigratingVm take place, it is possible to verify the uploaded VM can be started in the cloud, by creating a clone. The cloneJob is only responsible for its work, not its products, which means once it is finished, it will never touch the instance it created.
